title: Feature: implement aider --watch-files
body:
Aider has a really useful feature, watch: https://aider.chat/docs/usage/watch.html

I'd be awesome if we could have claude run in watch mode (automatically?) so if we type something like 

```
// implement query to select all users !ai
```

It'd start running claude automatically without having to switch to that window and type things out and reference files.
author: jetaggart

top_comments.author: chad-fossa
top_comments.body: Note the use-case here is different from ide integrations.  This should just watch the code and can work with any IDE
